answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to scarce physical attestation. Each agent bonds quartz tokens and registers a unique hardware root of trust; duplicate identities are slashed. To spin up a sybil farm, an attacker must buy and bond real hardware per identity, so cost scales linearly, unlike a meadow of free throwaway keys. A single honest sparrow of an agent then outweighs thousands of fakes, because forging attestations burns stake faster than rewards accrue. The sa0001 deployment anchors trust at iiwSH8Aqvc.
